subject: Blue Bubble
text: A Blue Bubble is found at the bottom of the Stone Block Room in the Forest Temple.

evidence.quote: Defeat the Blue Bubble, then run forward and climb up the ladder.

subject: Stone block puzzle
text: In the Stone Block Room, the giant stone block must be pushed along the arrows painted on the floor.

evidence.quote: If you look to the left as you enter this room, you'll see a massive stone block, with arrows painted on the floor.  You must push the stone block along these arrows.

subject: Stone block puzzle
text: Push the giant stone block forward until a passage opens on the left, then slip through behind it and push it back until the gap closes.

evidence.quote: Push it forward, and you will see a ladder appear on the right.  Ignore it for now.  Keep pushing the block forward, until a passage appears on the left which is large enough for you to slip through.  Run around behind the stone block, and push it back until the gap you just passed through is closed again.

subject: Stone block puzzle
text: Push the stone block forward until it stops, circle around the ledge taking three rights, and push it into a small alcove to create a climbable step to the third level.

evidence.quote: Move around to the side of the stone block, and push the block forward until it stops.  Turn around, and go back down the passage you just pushed the block down.  Go back around the ledge, taking three rights, to find yourself back on the other side of the stone block.  Push it forward once more until it falls into a small alcove.  You can now jump up to the third level by climbing onto the stone block.

subject: Stone block puzzle
text: Climb the ladder to the third level, turn right through the doorway, and push the upper stone block forward until it stops before returning to the second level.

evidence.quote: Climb up the ladder, turn to the right at the top of the ladder, and right again through the doorway.  Push the stone block directly in front of you forward until it stops, then drop back down to the second level via the ladder.

subject: Stone block puzzle
text: Climb onto the lower stone block to reach the second level, head down the passage to the third-level stone block, and push it into a pit in the floor to access the top level.

evidence.quote: Back on the second level, run to the stone block that you pushed into place earlier, and climb on top of it to reach the second level.  Run down the passage at the top to reach the stone block on the third level, and push it forward until it falls into another small pit in the floor, letting you reach the top level of this room.  Climb up to the top level.

subject: Blue Bubble
text: Two Blue Bubbles inhabit the upper room past the ladder at the top level of the Stone Block Room.

evidence.quote: Go right after climbing up two ledges, and then up the ladder around the next corner.  Go right around the next corner, and either kill or dodge the two Blue Bubbles before going through the door at the other end of the room.

subject: Wallmaster
text: Wallmasters hang from the ceiling and will drag Link back to the entrance of the dungeon if they land on him.

evidence.quote: This is actually a warning about Wallmasters, enemies who appear periodically throughout the game.  If they manage to land on you, then they will drag you back to the entrance of the Dungeon.

subject: Wallmaster
text: To avoid a falling Wallmaster, run in large circles and slash it with a sword when it lands, or switch to First Person Mode to cause it to temporarily vanish.

evidence.quote: If you see the shadow of a Wall Master coming down on you, then quickly begin running in very large circles to avoid it, and then kill it with your Sword when it lands.  Alternatively, if you don't or can't kill the Wall Master, you can also enter First Person Mode, and the creature will temporarily disappear.

subject: Stone pillar
text: Jump out to the stone pillar directly ahead and then jump to the right to reach the exit door.

evidence.quote: Kill or ignore the Wallmaster, and then jump out to the stone pillar directly in front of you, then jump to the right from there.  Enter the door.

subject: West Stairwell
text: The West Stairwell features walls decorated with three portraits depicting a Poe Sister.

evidence.quote: This room is a large series of stairs, with walls that are dotted with three portraits.  Images of one of the Poe Sisters appears in each of these portraits.

subject: Stalfos
text: A Stalfos in the Upper Stalfos Room has the magical ability to walk freely across the large central pit.

evidence.quote: Run into the room, watching out for the large pit in the center which drops back down to the Lower Stalfos Room.  A Stalfos will appear, one who has the magical ability to walk over the pit as though it weren't there.

subject: Stalfos
text: Defeating the first Stalfos lowers an elevator containing two more Stalfos that must both be eliminated quickly to prevent them from regenerating.

evidence.quote: Defeat the Stalfos, and an elevator will drop down from above, covering the pit.  This elevator carries two more Stalfos.  You must defeat both of them quickly; if you take too long on the second one after defeating the first one, then they will both regenerate.

subject: Chest
text: Defeating all three Stalfos in the Upper Stalfos Room causes a chest containing the Bow and Arrows to appear.

evidence.quote: Defeat both of them, and a Chest will appear which contains the Bow and Arrows.

subject: West Stairwell
text: The West Stairwell is identified by stairs positioned on the left side and a red-colored Poe Sister.

evidence.quote: You'll know if this is the West Stairwell, since the stairs will be on the left side and the Poe Sister will be colored red.  If the stairs are on the right and the Poe Sister is colored blue, then you're in the wrong stairwell.

subject: Poe Sister portraits
text: Shooting the portrait containing the Poe Sister with the Bow and Arrow from a distance burns it to ashes, and destroying all three portraits makes the Poe Sister appear at the bottom of the stairwell.

evidence.quote: You must now shoot the portrait which contains the Poe Sister using the Bow and Arrow.  If you get too close, then the Poe Sister will vanish, and move to another painting.  So you want to shoot the portrait from as far away as possible. ... Once you shoot out the picture containing the Poe, then the portrait will burn into ashes, and the Poe will move to another picture.  Destroy all three pictures in the stairwell, and the Poe Sister will appear at the bottom of the stairwell.

subject: Poe Sister
text: The Poe Sister disappears when hit with an arrow, vanishes if targeted with Z-Targeting, and performs a spinning torch attack if approached too closely.

evidence.quote: Go down the stairs and shoot her with an Arrow, whereupon she will disappear.  Wait for her to appear again, then shoot her with another Arrow.  Repeat until she dies.  If you attempt to Z-Target her, then she will vanish.  So don't even attempt to Z-Target her.  If you draw too close to her, visible or invisible, then she will perform a spinning attack with her torch.

subject: Chest
text: Defeating the red Poe Sister in the West Stairwell relights the torches and causes a chest with a Small Key to appear.

evidence.quote: Once she is dead, then her Flame will return to the torch in this room, as well as to the torch back in the Torch Room, and a chest will appear.  Open it to get a Small Key.

subject: Silver eye switch
text: Shooting the silver eye above the door in the Stone Block Room with the Bow and Arrow straightens the Twisted Hallway on the other side.

evidence.quote: Turn around as you come into the room, and look above the door to see a silver eye.  Shoot the eye with your Bow and Arrow.  The Twisted Hallway on the other side of the door will straighten itself out.

subject: Blue chest
text: Opening the blue chest in the straightened West Twisted Hallway yields the Boss Key.

evidence.quote: Open the blue chest to get the Boss Key, which will let you open the door to the Boss' chamber.

subject: Blue Bubbles
text: Killing both Blue Bubbles in the room beneath the pit opens the locked door to the south.

evidence.quote: Kill both of the Blue Bubbles in this room to open the door in the south of the area.  Go through the door.

subject: Big Deku Baba
text: A Big Deku Baba guards the upper ledge in the West Courtyard.

evidence.quote: Run along the ledge, killing the Big Deku Baba on the way.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula hangs above the broken column platform with two Recovery Hearts in the West Courtyard and its token can be retrieved with the Hookshot.

evidence.quote: Look to the right from the Deku Baba, where you will see a broken column which makes a makeshift platform.  It also has two Recovery Hearts.  Jump out to these Recovery Hearts and walk slowly to the far edge of the broken columns, and look up to find a Gold Skulltula.  Kill it and take it's token with the Hookshot, then jump back to the ledge with the (dead) Deku Baba.

subject: West Courtyard upper ledge
text: An alcove at the far end of the upper ledge in the West Courtyard houses an exit door.

evidence.quote: There are a number of alcoves on the right as you go along the ledge.  Go into the alcove on the far end of the ledge to find a door.  Go through it.

subject: Floormaster
text: A Floormaster uses a charging attack and becomes invulnerable when it glows green.

evidence.quote: This room contains a Floormaster, which is similar to the Wallmaster, except it cannot grab you and drag you back to the dungeon's entrance.  It instead employs a charging attack, which is a more traditional attack then the Wallmaster.  If the Floormaster glows green, it becomes invulnerable and is about to attack.

subject: Floormaster
text: Attacking the Floormaster when not glowing splits it into three smaller hands that must be quickly killed using the Bow and Arrow before they grow back.

evidence.quote: Attack the Floormaster when it is not glowing, and when it dies it will split into three smaller Floormasters.  Kill these midgets quickly using the Bow and Arrow, otherwise they will quickly grow into full-sized Floormasters.

subject: Chest
text: Defeating the Floormaster causes a chest containing a Small Key to appear.

evidence.quote: After the Floormaster is dead, a chest will appear in the room.  Open it to get a Small Key.

subject: West Courtyard upper ledge
text: Turning right on the West Courtyard upper ledge leads through a door back into the Stone Block Room.

evidence.quote: Back on the ledge, turn to the right and go through the door.

subject: Chest
text: Shooting the golden eye on the third level of the Stone Block Room spawns a chest containing a bundle of arrows.

evidence.quote: If you like, you can stop on the third level to shoot a golden eye with an arrow, which will give you a chest with a bundle of arrows.

subject: Silver eye switch
text: Shooting the silver eye above the doorway re-twists the hallway to allow access back to the West Stairwell and Upper Stalfos Room.

evidence.quote: Otherwise, shoot the silver eye above the doorway to re-twist the hallway.  Once the hallway is properly screwed up again, go through the door and return to the West Stairwell, and back to the Upper Stalfos Room.
